svg.text: B1 — Figure 5 relative-error sky domes with Algorithm32
Color: 360–720 nm band-integrated directional relative error. Number below each dome: spectral-radiance RMSE (mW m⁻² sr⁻¹ nm⁻¹).
Published-model domes are the unchanged image XObjects embedded in Bruneton Figure 5; they are not locally rerendered model outputs.
Algorithm32 is the selected cumulative-through-order-4 boundary and uses the same B1 9×9 inputs, spherical interpolation, percentage palette, Sun marker, and sample markers.
